column3: (Cookie No HttpOnly Flag: the session cookie must stay HttpOnly)
(Cookie Without Secure Flag: production cookies are Secure)
(Missing Anti-clickjacking Header: Caddy and the API send X-Frame-Options DENY and frame-ancestors 'none')
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing: nosniff on every response)
(Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set: Caddy sends HSTS)
(Content Security Policy Header Not Set: Caddy sets the SPA's CSP, the API default-src 'none')
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set: Caddy and the API send Permissions-Policy)
(Re-examine Cache-control Directives: responses are Cache-Control no-store, which is stricter than the directives the rule asks for)
(Suspicious Comments: words like "user" or "query" in the minified third-party JavaScript bundle, not comments we wrote)
(Non-Storable Content: intended. The SPA shell and API answers are no-store so signed-in data is never cached, ASVS 8.2.1)
(Modern Web Application: informational, the app is a single-page app)
